beats.caption: Trumman West. Here is the story of Trumman West and its twenty families, from 1901 to 1926.
The censuses of 1901, 1911 and 1926 counted 71, 66 and 81 people in Trumman West, in 14, 16 and 20 households. Heads of household included Harron, Colvin and Gorman.
Here are the families of Trumman West, from 1901 to 1926. First, the Gorman and Harron families.
The Gorman family appear in the records from 1901 to 1926.
